item.title: South Coast User Group - The Human Hack: Rebooting Consulting Culture
item.description: I’m heading to Southampton on Friday 23 October to present The Human Hack: Rebooting Consulting Culture at South Coast User Group. I’ll be joining Areti Iles and Dan Barber at 11:00 BST, bringing back the conversation we shared at Scottish Summit.
